asset_type: TaraHome smart-home blog cover, wide landscape editorial photograph
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: TaraHome smart-home blog cover, wide landscape editorial photograph
Primary request: Create a unique, topic-specific cover for a practical article about using Home Assistant to know when to open or close windows for passive summer cooling.
Scene/backdrop: A believable warm, lived-in residential living room at early summer evening. Natural oak flooring and side table, off-white plaster walls, linen curtains, a few real houseplants, and restrained dark-green accents. Through a large casement window, show a calm shaded garden in cooler blue-green dusk light while the indoor room still holds gentle warm late-day light.
Subject/action: An adult homeowner, shown naturally from the side or three-quarter back with realistic anatomy, is opening the real casement window and letting the linen curtain move slightly in the cooler air. The decision to ventilate should be understandable from the contrast between the warmer room and cooler evening outside. Keep the person and window central enough to survive a centered article-card crop. A phone may rest face-down on the oak side table, but do not show any screen or interface. Do not include smart-home hubs, branded sensors, or invented electronic hardware.
Style/medium: High-end but unforced residential editorial photography, documentary-real, practical and calm, realistic proportions and materials, not futuristic and not a staged product advertisement.
Composition/framing: 3:2 landscape at high resolution. Full-bleed scene with visual interest across the frame. Preserve the open window, moving curtain, and homeowner in both the full image and a centered 16:10 crop. No empty title-poster area and no graphic border.
Lighting/mood: Natural mixed warm indoor and cool outdoor evening light, subtle and physically plausible, reassuring and useful, realistic soft shadows.
Color palette: Warm cream, oak, linen, leafy green, muted sky blue, and restrained Tara dark green.
Materials/textures: Visible wood grain, woven linen, matte plaster, natural leaves, realistic glass reflections, normal home wear.
Constraints: no embedded words, letters, numbers, headline, caption, logo, brand mark, watermark, Home Assistant logo, readable phone screen, screen glow, floating interface, floating UI card, translucent panel, inset frame, progress bar, chart, graph, diagram, decorative route line, network path line, connection overlay, fake airflow arrows, fake temperature graphics, poster treatment, duplicated objects, surreal architecture, or invented product hardware.
Avoid: generic AI smart-home diagrams, glowing gadgets, sci-fi control rooms, corporate offices, empty luxury showrooms, blue-purple neon, fake dashboards, infographic symbols, weather icons, thermometers with impossible readings, repeated beige device arrangements, over-smoothed people, distorted hands, excessive depth-of-field blur.
